run_inference_generate_wav: run BigVGAN inference to generate wav audio from input wav files using a checkpoint model
run_inference_with_cuda_kernel: run BigVGAN inference with CUDA kernel optimization enabled for faster audio generation
run_inference_custom_dirs: run BigVGAN inference with custom input wav directory and output directory paths
run_inference_from_checkpoint: run BigVGAN inference loading a trained checkpoint and config.json to synthesize mel-based audio
run_main_entry_point: run the BigVGAN inference CLI entry point with required checkpoint file argument
